title: fraxinus caroliniana f. pubescens
intro: Fraxinus caroliniana f. pubescens, commonly known as the Carolina ash or southern ash, is a deciduous tree species found in the southeastern United States. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, helping to alleviate symptoms of fever, pain, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Fraxinus caroliniana f. pubescens include its use as an antipyretic, analgesic, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it a potential treatment for various conditions. Bioactive constituents of the plant, such as fraxin and fraxinol, contribute to its therapeutic properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
